patch.value: GH-1756: pm context counts in_progress_unowned and in_progress_idle over a different population than in_progress

Reported in GH-1756 against 2026.11.18. With a custom progress status (workflow.in_progress_status set to doing), the summary's in_progress counts items by the status role, but in_progress_unowned and in_progress_idle count items by the configured progress status. When doing carries the blocked role, pm context reports in_progress 0 alongside in_progress_unowned 2 and in_progress_idle 2, so the advisories exceed their own total. All three counts must describe the same population. The unowned in-progress hygiene and the idle advisory that introduced these counts are related.

For any status-role configuration, in_progress_unowned and in_progress_idle never exceed in_progress; A custom progress status is counted consistently by all three summary fields; Tests cover a custom progress status with the blocked role and with the active role
in_progress, in_progress_unowned and in_progress_idle count the same population, so neither advisory can exceed in_progress for any status configuration.
With a doing progress status whose role is blocked, pm context reports in_progress 0 while in_progress_unowned and in_progress_idle both report 2.
